assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent PNG animation sprite sheet for a side-scrolling anime witch travel portfolio. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal sized cells, on genuinely transparent background. In every cell same full-body normal-proportion (7-head tall, not chibi) young adult silver-haired traveling witch facing RIGHT in perfect side view, black wide pointed hat with muted plum ribbon, charcoal cloak with cream lining over white blouse, dark skirt, brown ankle boots, small tan leather shoulder bag. Delicate anime linework, soft painterly shadows, elegant whimsical travel atmosphere. Each figure fully fits its cell with generous margin, equal head and foot baseline for standing poses, centered. Row 1: 4 consecutive distinct walking-cycle poses (contact, down, passing, up). Row 2: idle standing, takeoff crouch, jumping airborne with knees bent, falling with cloak lifted. Row 3: mounting wooden broom, sitting astride broom horizontally hovering, leaning forward flying on broom, landing on broom. Broom bristles trailing left and handle pointing right; whole broom fits in cell. Same face costume proportions every cell. NO labels, NO letters, NO checkerboard, NO grid lines, NO scenery, NO ground, NO shadow underneath. Deliver a large crisp sprite sheet suitable for slicing, aspect ratio 4:3.
